name: astro-search-starter
title: Search Starter (Astro)
description: The flagship search site, statically generated: every document pre-rendered by the canonical PortableDoc at build, the corpus graph baked to JSON, live search browser-direct — pure static files, symlink-swap deploys.

env.description: Barkpark API base the BUILD reads from (the deployed site carries no token).
Public-read token. Used at build AND inlined into the browser bundle for live search — never use a token above public-read.
The content type the site builds from — the seeded reference-rich entry corpus.
